summary: cp copies, mv moves or renames, and rm deletes. Each one takes the source first and the destination second.
notes: mv old/notes-backup.txt old/notes-week1.txt renames the file, because the folder stays the same and only the name changes.
The second rm old/notes-week1.txt fails with rm: cannot remove 'old/notes-week1.txt': No such file or directory, because the first one already deleted it.
rm -r music-copy old deletes two folders and everything inside them. Check the names before you press Enter.
pitfall: rm on a folder fails with rm: cannot remove 'music-copy': Is a directory. Add -r to remove a folder, and be careful: rm does not ask and does not use a trash can.
